scope: Staged background analysis (request, one unit per step, status) under the existing statement limit; the reference captured once in one statement through the bounded sources (operational, finance DEFERRED); a staged run kept apart from cp7_analysis_native.runs (every whole reader refuses it) and read as a header plus byte-adaptive pages bound by identity_hash, actor, run and current access epoch; refusal equality with the single path; source check UNCHANGED/ARCHIVED_STALE
parity: P19G_STAGED_EQUALS_SINGLE compares the reassembled analysis (header prefix plus every page's items) with cp7_analysis_native.build on the job's own stored reference, query, run id and access (semantic_hash excluded: the staged path does not compute it); byte identity of the analysis text and the Original is proven by the kernel tests (f05-staged-api)
five_thousand_point: measured by the scale ladder (P19 Scale, p19-scale5) through the same public RPCs and the browser control, recorded as a background exception, never as a met 3 s target
synthetic_case: none; P19G_STAGED_BOUNDS_VS_SINGLE seeds 100 then 140 current targets through the scale ladder's ordinary writers inside its rolled-back case
snapshot_v2: Contract v2 (docs/cp7/p19/P19_STAGED_SNAPSHOT_V2.md, owner decision 8 Oct 2026). P19G_SNAPSHOT_FRESHNESS: time label, changes per category including a backdated entry and a deletion, recorded full checks, every state; one test transaction, so boundaries by recording time. P19G_RACE_SNAPSHOT_IN_FLIGHT: real transactions; a write running at the capture and one running at a full check count once committed although recorded before the boundary, a deletion by another transaction counts. The snapshot is never called current: a full check only reports sameness as of its own time (same_as_of).
